heading: Experience That Goes Beyond Training
blockquote: Behaviour cannot be rushed, forced or ignored. It must be understood.
body:
With more than 26 years of hands-on experience working with dogs of different breeds, personalities and behavioural needs, Liza combines professional grooming expertise with specialist knowledge of canine behaviour.

Years of supporting nervous, fearful and reactive dogs have shaped a calm, practical approach based on observation, trust and what is right for the individual dog. Recommendations are never taken from a template. They are shaped by the dog in front of us, the challenges they face and the environment in which they live.
